reason: Surfaced by uploaded-file-read-drops-rails-length-and-buffer-arguments (a `read` that takes arguments now exists in actiondispatch, so gate 2 admits `read`): Rails calls `body_stream.read` INSIDE the `reset_stream` block (request.rb:511-517) and trails does the same (request.ts:694-696), but the extractor reads the arrow-function argument as a call that precedes its callee, so the order is an artifact of the TS spelling, not a reordering.
